data.name: PrivacyIntro
data.value: How {0} handles personal data, in plain words.

data.name: PrivacyS1Body
data.value: Organizers: email address, display name, preferred language and the games they create. Players: only a nickname they choose, plus the lineup and points of that nickname; no account and no email. Elements in play: the name and details the organizer enters and, optionally, an email address used only to send the consent request. Referees: a display name and an access link.

data.name: PrivacyS2Body
data.value: To run the game you take part in, to send sign-in links and consent requests, and to protect the service from abuse (for example by limiting how often an address can try to sign in). We do not sell data and we do not use it for advertising.

data.name: PrivacyS3Body
data.value: Only what the service needs to work: the sign-in cookie of organizers, your language and theme choices, and the access token of a player or referee on their own device. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

data.name: PrivacyS4Body
data.value: A game and its data stay until the organizer deletes them or deletes their account. Photos are not available yet; when they are, they will be removed 30 days after the game ends. Sign-in links expire shortly after they are sent.

data.name: PrivacyS5Body
data.value: Organizers can download a copy of their data and delete their account and games at any time from the account page. Players and people in play can ask the organizer of the game to access, correct or delete their data, or to leave the game, and can object to the processing. You can also complain to your data protection authority.

data.name: PrivacyS6Body
data.value: Contact details are never passed to a sponsor without a separate, explicit consent from the person concerned.

data.name: TermsIntro
data.value: The few rules that keep {0} fun and fair for everyone.

data.name: TermsS1Body
data.value: Organizers create games, choose what is in play and set the rules; players join with a nickname and follow the leaderboard. You use the service at your own responsibility and in line with the law.

data.name: TermsS2Body
data.value: Put people in play only with their consent, and let them leave when they ask. Rules are about light-hearted, observable moments, never about the quality, performance or evaluation of people. Do not collect personal data of minors through the service. Games must not involve money, paid entries tied to prizes or betting.

data.name: TermsS3Body
data.value: Choose a nickname that is not offensive or misleading. Do not try to disturb the service, guess access links or play on behalf of others.

data.name: TermsS4Body
data.value: The service is provided as it is. We work to keep it available during your event but cannot guarantee uninterrupted operation, so keep a fallback for important events.

data.name: TermsS5Body
data.value: We may update these terms; the current version is always on this page.
